name: June 2022 Update -> Spacebot Concept - Prototype 2
author: CreativeTherapyCo
description:
June 15 Update: Now you can shoot and defeat enemies,  get hurt if hit by enemy fire and fail or complete the first mission. 

About this project: We created Spacebot during buddy jam and are looking to get early feedback on this prototype as we continue development. Read on for more details and to get a sense of the vision for this game.

### Description

Spacebot was sent to the Nu Solar System for one simple job: to harvest oxygen. But how can she do that when the human colonies there need her help? Free 1000 human colonies and help them survive, using diplomacy or hostile warfare.

### Gameplay

Free captured human colonies, defend them from attack, and manage their resources! Your goal is to get to 1000 human colonies and (hopefully) keep them as healthy and happy as possible.

### Theme

Spacebot meets the 1000 theme because his goal is to save 1000 human colonies.

### Controls

Left Stick (gamepad), WASD/arrow keys, stick (joystick), primary 2D axis (xr controller)
Aim and Fire / Interact with button: Right Trigger (gamepad), left button (mouse), Top (touch screen), Trigger (Joystick), prime action (xr controller), space (keyboard)
